claims.text: Autoformer outperforms prior transformer and RNN baselines on ETTh1, ETTm1, Traffic at horizon 336.
Autoformer is best characterised as decomposition transformer with auto-correlation.

evidence.description: Reported MSE reduction of 12% versus the strongest prior transformer on ETTh1 at horizon 336.

limitations.text: Hyperparameters are tuned per-dataset, which advantages larger models that can absorb the added capacity.
Attention weights are not analysed, leaving the interpretability claims unverified.

future_work.text: Reporting per-seed variance and confidence intervals for the headline metric.
